scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w web" "npm run start -w server"
scripts.docker:up: node scripts/ensure-docker-env.mjs && node scripts/check-docker.mjs && docker compose --env-file docker.env up -d --build
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --env-file docker.env logs -f web api
scripts.docker:migrate: node scripts/check-docker.mjs && docker compose --env-file docker.env --profile migrate run --rm db-push
scripts.dev:docker: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:docker -w web" "npm run dev:docker -w server"
scripts.docker:dev: node scripts/ensure-docker-env.mjs && node scripts/check-docker.mjs && docker compose --env-file docker.env --profile dev up -d --build dev
scripts.docker:dev:down: docker compose --env-file docker.env --profile dev stop dev
